response.overview: Follows the quest of an ambitious advertising executive to fulfil her daughter's dream of attending a sought-after summer camp against the odds, when places fill up in record time. The determined mother reluctantly teams up with a former star athlete, who is helping his niece pursue the same dream, to compete in a series of camp-inspired challenges for a coveted spot at Camp Falcon Ridge. The pair are swept into outdoor adventures and cherished camp traditions, where an unforgettable group of Camp Rangers remind them that success is not always about accomplishments and sparks begin to fly on all levels as things do not go to plan.
response.title: Summer's Camp Romance
